findings.message: Possible narration comment ("now we...", "first, ..."). Verify ordering and other constraints before removing nonessential comments; explain relevant rationale in the final response.

const { selectedProjects } = await prompt().catch(() => ({ selectedProjects: null }));
if (!selectedProjects) return;
for (const matcher of matchers) { const error = await matcher().catch(e => e); expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(Error); }

interface Transport { send(data: string): void; close(): void; }
class Connection { constructor(private transport: Transport) {} send(data: string) { this.transport.send(data); } }
